findings.evidence: PosSemidef.lean:89-93 vs 97-105: identical `simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, map_apply, …]; sum_congr; sum_congr; simp only [mul_re, …]` structure, one factored, one inline.
findings.fix: Factor the identity as a standalone lemma (e.g. `Matrix.re_star_dotProduct_mulVec_ofReal (M : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x : n → ℝ) : re (star (fun i => (x i : 𝕜)) ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ fun i => (x i : 𝕜))) = x ⬝ᵥ (M.map re *ᵥ x)`), proved the same way as line 101-105, and make `map_re` `⟨hM.1.map re (by simp), fun x => (this ▸ hM.re_dotProduct_nonneg _)⟩`-style two lines.
findings.issue: `PosSemidef.map_re` inlines the identity `re (star (ofReal ∘ x) ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ (ofReal ∘ x))) = x ⬝ᵥ (M.map re *ᵥ x)` (lines 89-93) as an anonymous simp-only/sum_congr chain, hiding a reusable fact that the docstring itself names as the content of the lemma, while the symmetric identity `re_star_dotProduct_map_ofReal_mulVec` (line 97) is exposed as its own lemma.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Hermitian.lean:62 states `IsHermitian.apply` with `star`; mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Star/Basic.lean:353 `starRingEnd_apply … := rfl` is the defeq being relied on silently.
findings.fix: Obtain the `conj` form explicitly: `have hconj := by simpa using ρ.posSemidef.1.apply idxPP idxMM` (simp normalises `star` to `conj` on `ℂ` via `Complex.star_def`), or rewrite with `starRingEnd_apply`; apply the same at line 283.
findings.issue: `have hconj : conj (ρ.mat idxMM idxPP) = ρ.mat idxPP idxMM := ρ.posSemidef.1.apply idxPP idxMM` ascribes a `conj`-form type to a term whose stated type uses `star` (`Matrix.IsHermitian.apply : star (A j i) = A i j`); the match goes through the undocumented defeq `starRingEnd ℂ z ≡ star z`. Same at line 283 (`hconj` in `isTimeReversalInvariant_iff_isSymm`).

findings.evidence: ComplexSpinDensity.lean:368-371; `toSpinDensityC_re h : ρ.re.toSpinDensityC = ρ` has `ρ` on both sides.
findings.fix: Use the forward chain `rw [← SpinDensity.isParityInvariant_toSpinDensityC_iff, toSpinDensityC_re h]`, which rewrites the LHS to `ρ.re.toSpinDensityC.IsParityInvariant` and then collapses it to `ρ.IsParityInvariant`, closing by `Iff.rfl`.
findings.issue: `conv_rhs => rw [← toSpinDensityC_re h]` rewrites the variable `ρ` backwards into `ρ.re.toSpinDensityC`, an expression that itself contains `ρ`; this abstracts every occurrence of `ρ` on the RHS and is fragile if `IsParityInvariant` is ever unfolded or gains another `ρ` occurrence.

summary: Proofs are short and automation-driven, but `Matrix.PosSemidef.map_re` buries the reusable identity re(x̄ᵀ M x) = xᵀ (re M) x for real x inside a simp-only/sum_congr chain while its mirror `re_star_dotProduct_map_ofReal_mulVec` is factored out, and two `have` ascriptions rely on the undocumented defeq `starRingEnd ℂ z ≡ star z` to retype `IsHermitian.apply`.
